grammătista , ae, m., = γραμματιστής,
I.a teacher of grammar or of languages: “sunt qui litteratum a litteratore distinguant, ut Graeci grammaticum a grammatista: et illum quidem absolute, hunc mediocriter doctum existiment,” Suet. Gramm. 4 ; id. ib. 24; Mart. Cap. 3, § 229.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
